certificate.caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11 of the Security Policy
certificate.description: The Oracle Acme Packet 4600 and 6350 are a family of fixed, hardware appliances which provide secure and reliable IP communications as Session Border Controllers. These modules can be deployed in either service provider or enterprise environments. Both modules utilize hardware assist to perform services including encrypted signaling and media via TLS and SRTP. The two modules utilize the exact same software but vary only by performance and capacity.
